note: Machine-readable companion to SOURCE-ACQUISITION.md. No URL here was fetched or verified during this run; agency endpoints are blocked by network policy and operator feeds require authorization. Confirm the exact download path on arrival.

rules.weigh_station_is_not_parking: A weigh, inspection, scale, check station or port of entry is never counted as truck parking, surfaced on a parking page, or returned by a parking query unless the authoritative source explicitly confirms legal parking is permitted.
rules.no_scraping: Truck Parking Club inventory must not be reproduced without an authorized feed. No operator map may be scraped in place of an export.
rules.no_inferred_coordinates: No coordinate from a road midpoint, ZIP centroid, interpolation, geocoder guess or search snippet.
rules.no_invented_attributes: Space count, hours, restrictions and amenities stay null unless the source states them.
rules.no_speculative_parsers: Required columns are a checklist to verify on arrival, not a schema to code against before the file exists.
rules.canada_excluded_from_us_denominator: Canadian locations in an operator export are preserved in a separate manifest and excluded from every U.S. coverage denominator.
rules.no_invented_overnight_permission: A parking-space count confirms parking, not overnight legality. Where a source carries no overnight field, overnight permission, restrictions and duration stay unknown and no row may be offered as overnight or HOS-rest parking.
rules.absence_is_not_closure: A directory row absent from a single export is a closure CANDIDATE. It is never deleted or unpublished on that basis; closure review is a separate exercise with its own authorization.
rules.discovery_only_sources_never_supply_valu: A discovery_only source may inform which question to ask an authoritative source. It may never supply a value that lands in the directory, and no gate percentage may count a row that came from it.
rules.buying_a_product_is_not_a_licence: Purchasing a paid PDF, app or report does not license redistribution or extraction of its contents.
rules.stale_reference_is_not_a_source: A file of unknown provenance may be profiled for shape and magnitude. It may never be imported, and it is never grounds to unpublish, correct or delete a live row.

prohibitions: Do not scrape the site, its map endpoints or its mobile app APIs.
